scope: Same-election text and party-code comparison only; no identity adjudication, additional benchmark or prediction
eligibility: Only machine-reconciled original 2007 general-election tables with a unique, complete, non-negative integer maximum are compared. Six withheld tables receive no leading-candidate attribution.
nameRules: Remove exactly one recognized parenthesized party code wherever it occurs in the original candidate label; preserve the remaining literal name.
Literal equality is compared first, then case, ASCII punctuation and whitespace are removed for formatting equality.
Do not reorder tokens, expand initials, remove honorifics, change spelling, use fuzzy matching or merge identities.
An unsupported or ambiguous party label is not stripped or guessed.
partyRules: Compare exact source codes only: INC,NCP,MPP,CPI,IND,RJD,NPP.
Register party codes are scoped to the original historical source. No modern-party merger or alias is implied.
IND code agreement does not mean independent candidates share an organization.
